alt: Какой прекрасный солнечный денёк! (фильм) / Hiatari Ryoko! Yume no Naka ni Kimi ga Ita (Movie) / Sunny Ryoko! You Were There in a Dream Sunny Ryoko! You Were There in a Dream 陽あたり良好！ KA・SU・MI 夢の中に君がいた
description: The movie starts out with Katsuhiko going to the US, with Kasumi and Yusaku seeing him off at Narita. Two years later, Katsuhiko is a professional racer, and comes back to Japan to race (and to marry Kasumi). Yusaku`s hobby is photography.

en: Sunny Ryoko! You Were There in a Dream

The movie starts out with Katsuhiko going to the US, with Kasumi and Yusaku seeing him off at Narita.


Two years later, Katsuhiko is a professional racer, and comes back to Japan to race (and to marry Kasumi). Yusaku`s hobby is photography.
